note: A paper valuation for the benchmark: the positions are not real and Triad's spend is testnet USDC. It values each shipment's cargo so the intelligence spent can be compared with what it protected.

Copper cathodes, LME grade A.basis: LME copper official cash settlement, 23 Nov 2026

Copper cathodes, COMEX grade 1.basis: LME copper official cash settlement, 23 Nov 2026, used as a proxy for COMEX grade 1

Zinc ingots, SHG.basis: LME zinc official cash settlement, 23 Nov 2026

Copper concentrate.basis: contained copper: an assumed 25% Cu grade and 96.5% payable, at LME cash $12,165/t; treatment and refining charges ignored

Cobalt hydroxide.basis: contained cobalt: an assumed 30% Co and 60% payable, at a cobalt metal price of $33,525/t (19 Nov 2026; a market data series, not an LME settlement)
